visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of three golden-brown, shiny bagels resting on a metal cooling rack over a marble surface. A pair of hands enters the frame, picking up one bagel and tearing it apart to reveal two distinct pockets of orange filling and white cream cheese. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the bread's texture. (2) The scene transitions to a kitchen setting where a white spatula mixes a milky liquid and flour in a glass container to form a shaggy dough. A hand then secures a red lid onto the container. The background remains clean and white, suggesting a professional home kitchen or studio. (3) A stand mixer is shown kneading the dough at a high speed. Subsequently, the hands are seen dividing the dough into uniform balls and rolling them on a countertop. A white textured rolling pin flattens a piece of dough before the hands add a strip of orange paste and bits of white cheese, rolling it into a ring. (4) The camera captures the shaped bagels being boiled in a pan of simmering water on an induction stove. Next, the bagels are seen through the glass door of a lit oven, slowly browning on multiple racks. The tray is then pulled out, revealing perfectly baked, puffed bagels. (5) The final phase returns to the cooling rack where a hand presses down on a bagel to demonstrate its soft, elastic crumb. Another bagel is broken in half, showing the filling and rising steam, emphasizing the freshness of the baked goods. The visual tone is bright and warm.

The BGM consists of a bright, major-key acoustic guitar melody with light, steady percussion at approximately 105 BPM. A distinct, low-frequency tearing sound occurs as the bread is pulled apart. (2) As the narrator explains the mixing phase, rhythmic scraping and squelching sounds of dough being manipulated are audible. The BGM maintains a consistent volume underneath the speech, creating a relaxed instructional atmosphere. No environmental noise is detected in this studio-quality recording. (3) The acoustic texture changes to include the whirring of a mixer motor followed by the dull, percussive thuds of dough balls being rolled on a flat surface. The narrator's pitch fluctuates naturally as she provides instructions on filling the bagels. (4) The sound of water bubbling and splashing becomes prominent, marking the boiling step. This is followed by a mechanical click and the sliding sound of an oven rack. The BGM remains cheerful and continuous, with no gaps or pauses in the mix. (5) In the concluding phase, a soft squishing sound is heard when the bagel is pressed, demonstrating its softness. The narrator's arousal increases slightly toward the end, and the music resolves naturally with a gentle fade, concluding the high-fidelity audio track.
